description: Run lint, typecheck, and tests on every pull request
rationale: CI gates are the last line of defense before main

description: Fail fast on the first broken step — don't run downstream jobs
rationale: Fail-fast saves CI minutes and speeds feedback

description: Lock dependency versions and use lockfiles in CI
rationale: Unlocked deps cause non-reproducible builds and supply-chain risk

description: Build once, promote the same artifact across environments
rationale: Rebuilding per env breaks dev/prod parity

description: Define infra with Terraform, Pulumi, or CDK — no manual console edits
rationale: IaC provides review, audit, and reproducibility

description: Store secrets in a secret manager, never in CI env files committed to git
rationale: Secret sprawl leads to credential leaks

description: Every deploy must have a documented, tested rollback path
rationale: Forward-only deploys prolong outages when things break

description: Expose liveness and readiness probes for orchestration
rationale: Probes enable safe rolling updates and auto-recovery

description: Emit logs as structured JSON with consistent fields
rationale: Structured logs are queryable in aggregators like Loki or Datadog

description: Define SLOs and alert on burn rate, not raw error counts
Use blue-green or canary deployments for user-facing services
rationale: Gradual rollouts catch regressions before full exposure

description: Grant CI the minimum permissions needed per pipeline
rationale: Overprivileged CI tokens are a common breach vector

description: Scan container images for CVEs before deploy
rationale: Base image vulnerabilities propagate to every running container

description: Automate backups and periodically test restores
rationale: Backups that have never been restored often don't work
